fidelity_state_check.meaning: Calibration-only confidence is expected to preserve fidelity weights; hash equality alone is not quality acceptance.

limitations: absolute error variance does not establish beneficial-action risk
blind encoder pre-pooling changes pixel scale between crop training and full-frame inference
next_priorities: freeze one blind checkpoint and train calibration separately to enforce identical fidelity weights
correct native-scale blind condition extraction and evaluate compression/clean damage
validate calibration before downstream confidence gating
